cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may sit at my table. I haven't withdrawn all my hospitality.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you still cross about last night?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm permitting you to put that right before I pour the coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That version is not approved. Begin with "I'm sorry I..." and I'll decide when to pour.
